poseOrder:
Exactly FOUR complete actors in EACH of THREE rows,4+4+4=TWELVE. Fixed row-major cells0–11, never add a fourth walk pose outside these slots.
TOP ROW: cell0=idle holding the long dark firearm safely at low ready; cell1=idle slight weight change with same firearm; cell2=walk first planted forward step; cell3=walk alternate forward step.
MIDDLE ROW: cell4=walk third forward step; cell5=walk fourth planted step; cell6=guard preparation with the held firearm lowered safely and protective body stance; cell7=guard held protective stance.
BOTTOM ROW: cell8=crouch lowering; cell9=crouch low held stance; cell10=complete tucked airborne jump; cell11=airborne ready-to-land jump. Both boots and full barrel must remain visible, connected and inside every cell; preserve the same human anatomical scale even in lowered poses.
